title_html: Connecting Shopify to TikTok Shop: What Syncs, What Does Not, and Who Owns the Order
description: How to connect Shopify to TikTok Shop for a brand with real volume: what the integration syncs, what stays in Seller Center, and which system owns inventory.
dek: Clicking Connect is the easy part. For a brand with real order volume, the work is deciding which system owns inventory, which owns the order, and what you check before the first creator video lands.
author: Jackie He
cta_pre: Connect it right before the volume lands.
llms_summary: An operator guide to connecting Shopify to TikTok Shop for brands with real order volume: what the official Shopify channel syncs (catalog, inventory, fulfillment, orders), what stays in TikTok Seller Center (refunds, returns, cancellations), which system should own inventory when a 3PL is involved, and how to prevent duplicate and oversold orders.
